antesala.subtitulo: Pick a world, give it a character and watch it learn to live there.
mundos.pista: Each world tests something different. Missing ones can be installed right here.
mundos.error: Could not read the list of worlds.
mundos.elige_uno: Pick a ready world to continue.
mundo.minimo.desc: A small meadow with berries, mushrooms and a wolf. Ideal to watch it learn the basics.
mundo.archivos.desc: A biome of folders and files that sprout, rot and bite. It only touches its own biome.
mundo.crafter.desc: 2D survival with day and night: gather, craft tools, fight back and sleep. 22 achievements to unlock.
mundo.snake.desc: The classic snake, in real time in a browser. Needs an internet connection.
mundo.ajedrez.desc: Games against a four-level local opponent, or against Stockfish if you have it.

caracter.personalizado_desc: Tuned by hand with the sliders.
caracter.azar_nota: Traits will come from the seed.
rasgo.responsabilidad.desc: Prudence and respect for what it learned.
rasgo.extraversion.desc: Attraction to other creatures around it.
rasgo.umbral_miedo.desc: Minimum danger that triggers escape reflexes.

lab.desde: You came from “{seccion}” in the Nursery: this is the heartbeat step that explains it.
lab.desde_t5b: You came from “{seccion}” in the Nursery: its own view arrives in T5b; meanwhile, the heartbeat.
lab.subtitulo_t5a: How IdA works inside, heartbeat by heartbeat.
lab.truncada: Truncated recording: read up to the last complete line
lab.directo_vacio: There is no live life with heartbeats yet.
lab.latido_no_esta: Heartbeat {n} is not in this source (it keeps {max}).
lab.sin_fuente_texto: Start a life from the lobby (it can be opened live without recording it) or open a recording.
lab.detalle_vacio: Click a heartbeat step to see its pieces, its Components and its time; a piece, for its log; a Component, for its card.
lab.detalle_vacio_ing: Click a Component to see its card: what it does, its biological analogue, its design decision and its time.
lab.paso.onda.que: Each heartbeat starts with a new Wave: it copies what the previous one left (its ef becomes this one's ei) and the previous one goes to short-term memory.
lab.paso.onda.bio: Like a cortical processing cycle: each moment starts from the state the previous one left.
lab.paso.sentir.que: The Core's sensors turn what the world gives into raw pieces, without judging them: the body from inside, posture and what is outside.
lab.paso.sentir.bio: Sensory transduction: receptors turn stimuli into signals, before any judgement.
lab.paso.preatencion.que: Annotates what was sensed with its salience and a quick appraisal (danger, nourishment, novelty). It costs no attention and also runs asleep.
lab.paso.preatencion.bio: Bottom-up salience and innate appraisal in parallel and before the attention bottleneck (superior colliculus, the amygdala's fast route).
lab.paso.plasticidad.que: Each learning Component learns from the effect of the previous heartbeat's action, in its own part of memory.
lab.paso.plasticidad.bio: Synaptic plasticity is local and costs no attention; the eligibility trace tags what was active when acting.
lab.paso.regulacion.que: Instant rules set the heartbeat's deadline, how many pieces fit in attention (amplitude) and how much arousal can be given (power).
lab.paso.regulacion.bio: Brainstem arousal systems (locus coeruleus, reticular formation) set processing gain and pace from the body's state.
lab.paso.S1.que: The fast system: it interprets what threatens or feeds and proposes actions per need (flee, eat, take shelter). It spends attention first.
lab.paso.S1.bio: Subcortical survival circuits: amygdala, hypothalamus and periaqueductal grey.
lab.paso.S2.que: Recognises the familiar, values it by what was lived and felt, and proposes to explore, take refuge or return to remembered food.
lab.paso.S2.bio: Limbic and valuation system: hippocampus, ventral striatum and orbitofrontal cortex.
lab.paso.S3.que: Reasons with what it knows: propositions, beliefs and intentions; plans towards goals and corrects S1 and S2 when it is certain.
lab.paso.S3.bio: Prefrontal cortex: working memory, top-down control and planning. Under acute stress it gets no turn.
lab.paso.tribunal.que: Compares the Actions proposed by S1, S2 and S3 and picks one: under stress urgency rules; when calm, confidence; experience biases a little.
lab.paso.tribunal.bio: Action selection in the basal ganglia: several proposals compete and one is disinhibited.
lab.paso.actuar.que: The Core executes the decision as world primitives (the body's motor layer translates the intention) and judges whether it worked.
lab.paso.actuar.bio: Motor cortex and spinal cord: intention becomes muscle synergies; the cerebellum compares the predicted with what happened.
lab.paso.cierre.que: Tags what to keep (by arousal and feedback), forms episodes from short-term memory and updates the body's indicators.
lab.paso.cierre.bio: Early consolidation: what was intense and mattered is tagged for episodic memory (hippocampus).
lab.latido_ayuda: The Wave (yellow dot) travels through the steps and lingers where more time was spent. Click a step for its detail.
lab.latido_ayuda_quieto: Reduced motion: the heartbeat is shown without animation. Click a step for its detail.
lab.sin_tiempo_regulacion: not timed separately: computed when the Wave is created
lab.solo_aprende: no time of its own: learns in step 4
lab.regulacion_fase_a: when the Wave is created (phase A, D12)
lab.amplitud_ayuda: New pieces this system put into attention, over the heartbeat's maximum
lab.potencia_ayuda: Arousal this system gave or changed, over the heartbeat's maximum
lab.entran: Comes in ({n} pieces from earlier steps)
lab.sin_piezas: This step creates or modifies no pieces in this heartbeat.
lab.sin_completo: This record is not at the full level: per-Component times and each piece's log are missing.
lab.tribunal_formula: base = arousal × stress + confidence × (1 − stress); active and proactive: experience bias; plus: continuity with what was already being done.
lab.cambio_experiencia: Experience changed the decision in this heartbeat.
lab.plus_decide: The continuity plus decided the winner.
lab.plasticidad_sin_tiempo: The record times plasticity as a whole, not each Component.
lab.pieza_no_esta: That piece is not in this heartbeat.
lab.registro_pieza: Log (who created it and who touched it)
lab.preatentivo_ayuda: Runs in pre-attention (step 3): costs no attention and keeps running asleep
lab.plastico_ayuda: Learns in step 4 (plasticity) from the previous action's effect
lab.sin_analogo: No honest biological analogue: it is a piece of IdA's engineering.
lab.sin_tiempo: No time of its own in the record: its work happens in plasticity.
lab.sin_tiempo_estrategia: A strategy runs inside its system's Strategy Component: it has no time of its own.
lab.sin_tiempo_biblioteca: A body library runs inside whoever uses it: it has no time of its own.
lab.decision_previa: Older than the reorganisation into Components (no decision of its own).
lab.sin_ficha: There is no card for “{autor}” in the Component map.
lab.ing_resumen: Heartbeat {latido} · cognition {ms} · deadline {plazo} ms · guillotines in the source: {g} of {n} heartbeats
lab.leyenda_tiempo: bar: this heartbeat · tick: mean (log scale)
lab.ver_no_montados: Also show what {mundo} does not mount ({n})
lab.grabaciones_ayuda: Lives recorded from the Nursery or the lobby, in datos/grabaciones. They open in the player; deleting asks for confirmation.
lab.sin_grabaciones: No recordings yet. Tick “Record this life” in the lobby or press “Record” in the Nursery.
lab.borrar_seguro: Delete {id} ({n} records)? This cannot be undone.
escena.pista: scene() check, not the Nursery. Load a .jsonl.gz or .jsonl recording, or a .json record.
escena.sin_escena: This record has no scene: text view.
escena.sin_gzip: This browser lacks DecompressionStream: decompress the recording and load the .jsonl.
sabe.fuentes: Where it knows it from: {manual} from the manual, {experiencia} from experience, {herencia} inherited, {biblioteca} from the library.
estirpe.resumen: {n} lives in the lineage · best points {score}
estirpe.resumen_1: 1 life in the lineage · best points {score}
estirpe.vacia: No life of this lineage has ended yet.
estirpe.guardar_ayuda: Saves to the collection a card with the last individual and its lineage's history.
estirpe.linaje_ayuda: It comes from the lineage saved on disk: it keeps up to 20 generations, those with the most points.
estirpe.sin_mutacion: With a single generation there is no mutation to see yet.
estirpe.adoptada: This lineage started by adopting a card from the collection.
companero.continuar_ayuda: {nombre}: generation {g} will be born ({n} lives in the lineage, best points {score}).
companero.continuar_ayuda_1: {nombre}: generation {g} will be born (1 life in the lineage, best points {score}).
companero.adoptar_ayuda: A saved card or lineage becomes your companion; the current one is archived in the collection.
companero.adoptar_ayuda_sin: A saved card or lineage becomes your companion.
companero.cero_ayuda: A new lineage; the current one is kept in the collection, not deleted.
companero.nueva_ayuda: This world has no companion yet: generation 1 will be born.
companero.coleccion_vacia: This world's collection is empty: save a companion from the Nursery or import a card.
companero.caracter_heredado: Character is inherited from its parent, with mutation; step 2 only counts when starting a new lineage.
companero.importar_ayuda: A JSON card (old panel cards too): it is selected for adoption.
companero.resumen_cero: new lineage (the current one is archived)
coleccion.subtitulo: Your companions, their archived lineages and saved cards, ranked by world.
coleccion.vacia_texto: When a life ends, your companion shows up here; from the Nursery you can save it as a card.
coleccion.nota_score: Points of a life: what orders the lineage (in Crafter, 1000 per achievement plus steps). Not the official benchmark Score, which is a percentage.
coleccion.adoptar_pregunta: Your current companion ({actual}) will be archived in the collection. Adopt?
coleccion.archivar_pregunta: The companion will move to the collection as an archived lineage (not deleted). Archive?
coleccion.borrar_ficha: The card is deleted from disk and cannot be recovered. Export it first if you want to keep it.
coleccion.borrar_estirpe: Its lineage and memory are deleted from disk and cannot be recovered. Export it first if you want to keep it.
coleccion.importada_avisos: Imported to the collection: {nombre} ({n} warnings: some data was missing)
error.sin_companero: This world has no companion yet.
error.elemento_desconocido: That card or lineage is not in the collection.
error.elemento_incompleto: That lineage was left half archived.
error.nombre_invalido: The name must have between 1 and 60 characters.
error.testigo_invalido: The confirmation expired or is not valid: nothing was deleted.

error.grabacion_invalida: That file is not an IdA recording.
